title: Write VC guide (jmap-chat-vc-guide.md): rooms, admins, membership via VCs
description:
Non-normative how-to guide: using Verifiable Credentials to gate Space creation, admin roles, and membership in JMAP Chat, as deployment patterns only. No draft changes; VCs stay outside the wire protocol (jmap-did #vc-relationship says wire-level VC presentation is a possible future capability).

Sections: 1 VC-gated Space creation (operator checks credential before Space/set create); 2 admins (VC -> SpaceRole with manage_*/ban; re-check on expiry); 3 membership (VC-gated join/invite, SpaceMember.roleIds from claims); 4 revocation/expiry (status lists; effect on roles; what federation peers do/don't see); 5 credential formats: W3C VC 2.0, ACDC (ToIP), SD-JWT VC (selective disclosure); 6 worked example: IETF/ASF/W3C liaison room, consistent with jmap-toip-mapping-guide.md §5 (mailbox-per-user federation, liaison mailboxes); 7 non-goals.

Every JMAP claim cites a draft section; every pattern labelled deployment pattern, not protocol feature. No BCP 14 keywords. Link from jmap-toip-mapping-guide.md §4 and jmap-did-guide.md with one sentence each.
close_reason: Guide written (jmap-chat-vc-guide.md), adversarially verified (6 defects fixed), linked from jmap-did-guide.md and jmap-toip-mapping-guide.md §4; 4 draft inconsistencies filed as bugs
